title: Gaps nobody proposed
overseerSummary: Candidates for the next proposal round: (1) the free 'Ask around' reroll lets you fish for raids at no cost; (2) summon has no roster cap and no sink besides the altar; (3) Field contract level reads only Gate clears, so a contracts-only player never levels; (4) out-of-fight regen fills a squad in about 40 real seconds, so fights on one map are independent; (5) hiding the tab resolves the current fight at once. Approve = I start a propose run with these as the focus after the build.
